options.content:
**Scope & caveats:**

- **No Project filter on this dashboard.** AI activity carries no project or repo association in the schema, so every AI-vs-human comparison here is necessarily company-wide.
- **AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed** compares two different populations: AI-session activity counts lines touched *inside* AI tool sessions (whether or not that code is ever committed or merged), while the human side counts lines in *merged* PR diffs only. This structurally overstates AI's share, since AI-touched lines aren't verified as AI-authored and can be edited or discarded by a developer before ever being committed. Read the percentage as an upper bound on AI's contribution, not a precise attribution.
- **AI-Attributed Volume by Language is Claude Code OTel-only.** Cursor's usage data has no language dimension, and the unified AI-tool-decisions table drops the language column that OTel's raw telemetry carries — so this panel is queried directly from that OTel table rather than the shared domain layer, and reflects Claude Code usage only.

panels.description: AI-session lines added ÷ (AI-session lines added + merged-PR additions), company-wide. Compares two different populations — see the caveat above — so read this as an upper bound on AI's contribution, not an exact attribution.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ai.ai_lines / NULLIF(ai.ai_lines + human.human_lines, 0), 1) AS "AI-Attributed Share %"
FROM
  (SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS ai_lines FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date)) ai,
  (SELECT SUM(additions) AS human_lines FROM pull_requests WHERE status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)) human

panels.title: AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed (Company-wide)

panels.description: Distinct engineers with AI activity ÷ distinct name-deduplicated PR-merging contributors, company-wide. The two counts aren't cross-matched to the same identity — an AI user isn't verified to also be a PR-merging contributor — so this is a directional adoption trend rather than an exact percentage, and can read above 100% when the two populations diverge.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * ai.n / NULLIF(c.n, 0), 1) AS "Engineers Adopted %"
FROM
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date) AND user_email != '') ai,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date)) c

panels.title: Engineers Adopted % (Company-wide)

panels.description: Total lines added inside AI tool sessions, company-wide (`SUM(ai_activities.lines_added)`).

targets.rawSql: SELECT SUM(lines_added) AS "AI Lines Added" FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: AI Lines Added (Company-wide)

panels.description: Accepted AI code suggestions ÷ suggestions offered, company-wide. Cursor records offered/accepted counts directly on its activity rows; Claude Code (OTel) records them on a separate tool-decisions table — both are combined into one acceptance rate.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ai_acceptance_daily AS (
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, suggestions_count AS offered, acceptance_count AS accepted
  FROM ai_activities WHERE record_kind IS NULL AND suggestions_count > 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date, provider, user_email, (accepted_count + rejected_count) AS offered, accepted_count AS accepted
  FROM ai_tool_decisions
)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted) / NULLIF(SUM(offered), 0), 1) AS "Edit Acceptance %"
FROM ai_acceptance_daily WHERE $__timeFilter(date)

panels.title: Edit Acceptance % (Company-wide)
Share of Lines Changed, With Adoption

panels.description: Monthly share of lines changed attributed to AI sessions vs. merged human PR diffs, stacked to 100%. Engineers Adopted % is overlaid as a dashed line for reference, on its own scale since adoption typically runs well above code-share percentage. Carries the same population caveat as the AI-Attributed Share of Lines Changed KPI above.

targets.rawSql:
WITH months AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month FROM ai_activities WHERE $__timeFilter(date)
  UNION
  SELECT DISTINCT DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') FROM pull_requests WHERE status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(merged_date)
),
ai_m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') month, SUM(lines_added) v FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date) GROUP BY 1),
hu_m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') month, SUM(additions) v FROM pull_requests WHERE status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(merged_date) GROUP BY 1),
ai_users_m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(date, '%Y-%m-01') month, COUNT(DISTINCT user_email) n FROM ai_activities WHERE NOT (provider = 'claude' AND record_kind IS NULL) AND $__timeFilter(date) AND user_email != '' GROUP BY 1),
contrib_m AS (SELECT DATE_FORMAT(merged_date, '%Y-%m-01') month, COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(NULLIF(a.full_name,''), pr.author_name)) n FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN accounts a ON a.id = pr.author_id WHERE pr.status = 'MERGED' AND $__timeFilter(pr.merged_date) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(m.month, '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, 'AI-attributed' AS metric,
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(ai_m.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ai_m.v, 0) + COALESCE(hu_m.v, 0), 0), 1) AS value
FROM months m LEFT JOIN ai_m ON ai_m.month = m.month LEFT JOIN hu_m ON hu_m.month = m.month
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(m.month, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Human',
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(hu_m.v, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(ai_m.v, 0) + COALESCE(hu_m.v, 0), 0), 1)
FROM months m LEFT JOIN ai_m ON ai_m.month = m.month LEFT JOIN hu_m ON hu_m.month = m.month
UNION ALL
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(m.month, '%Y-%m-%d'), 'Engineers adopted',
  ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(au.n, 0) / NULLIF(COALESCE(c.n, 0), 0), 1)
FROM months m LEFT JOIN ai_users_m au ON au.month = m.month LEFT JOIN contrib_m c ON c.month = m.month
ORDER BY time, metric

panels.title: AI vs Human Share of Lines Changed (Company-wide, monthly), With Adoption
AI-Attributed Volume by Language (Claude Code OTel only)

panels.description: Monthly accepted-edit volume by programming language, from Claude Code OTel telemetry. OTel-only, plugin-internal source — neither the shared AI-tool-decisions table nor Cursor carry a language dimension, so this reflects Claude Code usage only.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT STR_TO_DATE(DATE_FORMAT(hour_start, '%Y-%m-01'), '%Y-%m-%d') AS time, language AS metric, SUM(accepted_count) AS value
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY metric, time

panels.title: Accepted Edits by Language (Company-wide, monthly)

panels.description: Exact accepted/rejected edit totals by language from the same Claude Code OTel source as the chart above, with a per-language acceptance-rate column.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT language AS "Language", SUM(accepted_count) AS "Accepted Edits", SUM(rejected_count) AS "Rejected Edits",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(accepted_count) / NULLIF(SUM(accepted_count) + SUM(rejected_count), 0), 1) AS "Acceptance %"
FROM _tool_claude_code_otel_hourly_tool_usage
WHERE $__timeFilter(hour_start)
GROUP BY language
ORDER BY SUM(accepted_count) DESC

panels.title: Accepted / Rejected Edits by Language (Company-wide, totals)
